feedback: Written before this candidate has raced. It is iteration 3's best-raced design (score 685.6: oval 20/20, s-bend 17/20, slalom 0/20) with one change, mass 0.6 to 0.45 kg. Sensors (five at 16 mm, x = -0.03 to +0.03 m), weights [-2,-1,0,1,2], kp 4.0, kd 1.0, base_speed 1.5 and last_direction line loss are unchanged. Iteration 2 showed that raising kp to 4.5 cost oval and s-bend completion, so keeping kp at 4.0 is correct. Be aware that the mass-only effect is not isolated in the evidence: iteration 3 changed mass and kd together, so the slalom gain it produced cannot be attributed to mass alone. This race is the first clean test of mass. Plan the next revision from telemetry. If oval or s-bend completion drops below iteration 3 (100% and 85%), or steering_oscillation rises above about 0.35, the lighter robot is probably under-damped: return mass to 0.6 and raise kd to 1.2 instead. If slalom still ends off track with max_error near 0.065 and line_loss_events not falling below about 1.0, the next lever is a sensor lead (move the sensors toward y = 0.06 m) or a small kd increase, not kp. Approving now is reasonable: the candidate is valid, it is a single-variable move from the best-known base, and the race will tell us whether the mass lever matters.
requested_changes: If oval or s-bend completion falls below iteration 3 (100% and 85%), or steering_oscillation rises above about 0.35, return geometry.mass to 0.6 and set controller.kd to 1.2. Basis: iteration 2 showed that pushing the controller harder raised steering_oscillation to 0.34 to 0.39 and cost completions, and a lighter robot has less yaw damping.

If slalom still leaves the track with max_error near 0.065 and line_loss_events stay above about 1.0, move the sensors forward (geometry.sensor_positions y toward 0.06 m) before changing kp. Basis: slalom max_error has stayed at 0.063 to 0.065 across iterations 0 to 4 and kp changes have not helped.

If the mass change is neutral or positive, keep mass at 0.45 and test kd in steps of 0.2 (1.0 to 1.2) for slalom line-loss events. Basis: iteration 3 slalom line_loss_events fell from 1.1 (iteration 1) to 1.25, which does not yet show a clear gain from the mass and kd combination, so the damping lever is still untested on its own.
